introduction: DC Medicaid pays for covered health services for eligible residents. District Direct and DHS service centers provide application routes.
description: DC Medicaid pays for covered health services for eligible residents. District Direct and DHS service centers provide application routes.

sections.who: Eligibility depends on the relevant coverage group and financial and status rules. Children, pregnant applicants, adults, older residents and people with disabilities may use different pathways.
sections.get: Covered services can include doctor and hospital care, prescriptions, dental care and other authorized treatment. Confirm that a provider accepts DC Medicaid.
sections.docs:
• Household and income information.
  • Identity, address and requested status records.
  • Current insurance and any additional verification requested for the coverage group.
sections.apply:
1. Submit the application

    Use District Direct, the mobile app or the paper routes on DHS Public Benefits.

  2. Complete verification

    Respond to case-specific evidence requests and keep the submission confirmation.

  3. Read the notice

    Check the decision for each applicant and any instructions for plan enrollment.
sections.after: Carry your Medicaid card to appointments and report other health insurance. Keep renewal and contact details current.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DC Medicaid services; DHS application routes. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
